title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1010 | 百年新野猫、金字塔鳄鱼、太空皮卡丘
ending_game: Lina 的无厘头二选一：抱抱小野猫，还是骑在鳄鱼化石背上？你选哪个？

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey everyone, welcome back! I'm Mia.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Saturday, October tenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We've got three brand-new stories for you today! All super fresh!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fresh like my socks? I changed them today!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Even fresher! Story one! Scientists found a brand-new wild cat!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A new cat?! Like my neighbor's cat?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It LOOKS like a regular house cat! That's the funny part! People in Bolivia saw it for years and thought, oh, just a cute kitty!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Plot twist! It's NOT a kitty?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It's a whole new species! Called the Tilkayo tiger cat! It has leopard spots! And get this, it's the first new wild cat found in one hundred years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: One hundred years?! That's older than grandma!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Way older! It's tiny, with round ears. So cute! Can you believe it?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I have one? Please please please?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It's wild, sweetie. But here's our word of the day: fossil. A fossil is what's left of an animal or plant from super long ago, turned into rock!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like dinosaur bones?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! Say it with us, friends! Fossil!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fossil!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I love how you said that! Okay, story two! You know the Great Sphinx in Egypt? The giant lion with a human head?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The one with no nose?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Yes! Well, scientists found a fossil INSIDE the rock the Sphinx is carved from!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Inside?! Was someone hiding it there?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It was waiting there for forty-five million years! It's a brand-new species of ancient crocodile with a super long, skinny snout! They named it after Horus, an Egyptian god!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A crocodile god?! Does it wear a crown?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! I love how you think! Maybe a tiny crown!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I knew it!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, last story, and it's my favorite! A Pikachu toy spent sixty-seven days in space!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: WHAT?! Pikachu went to space?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! It floated around the International Space Station for sixty-seven days! I know, it's amazing!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did it catch any space Pokémon?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Maybe! And now there's a Pokémon Space Trail at a museum in London, where kids learn about space with Pokémon!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want to go! Can Pikachu be my teacher?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Best teacher ever! Okay, it's game time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh, my favorite! Would you rather... cuddle the tiny Tilkayo tiger cat, or ride on the back of the giant fossil crocodile?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hmm, tough one... I'd cuddle the kitty! Those round ears! What about you, friends? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I'd ride the crocodile! Giddy-up, Horus!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I love it! Amazing choice!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Thanks for hanging out with us! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm going to find a fossil!

vocab.def: what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
a group of animals or plants that are all the same kind
vocab.ex_en: a new species of wild cat

vocab.def: the nose and mouth part of an animal
to stay in the air or on water without falling down

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1011 | 猎豹五胞胎、远古水獭、火星伴蜂巢
ending_game: 谜语时间：有斑点像豹、跑得比汽车快、会喵喵叫，但不是家猫——我是谁？

vocab.def: a baby animal, like a baby lion or bear
to put things on top of each other
what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
a group of the same things close together

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey everyone, welcome back! I'm Mia.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Sunday, October eleventh!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We've got three amazing stories for you today! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ready ready ready! Go go go!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Five baby cheetahs were just born!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Five?! That's a lot of babies!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I know! At the Smithsonian Zoo! Their mom is named Zura, and it's her first time being a mom!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Is she doing a good job?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: She's doing great! The cubs are so tiny, they pile on top of each other to nap! And you can watch them on a live camera!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A cheetah channel?! I want to watch!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Me too! And here's our word of the day: cub. A cub is a baby animal, like a baby lion, a baby bear, or a baby cheetah!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So I'm a human cub?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Human babies are just called babies, silly! But I like how you think! Say it with us, friends! Cub!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Cub!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it! Okay, story two! Scientists found a fossil of an animal that lived with the dinosaurs!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A dinosaur?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not quite! It was a mammal, like us! It lived one hundred sixty-five million years ago in China! It looked like a cross between an otter and a beaver!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: An otter-beaver?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! It swam with its front legs and steered with its flat tail! And get this, it could chew its food AND breathe at the same time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I can do that! Watch! Nom nom nom!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! Careful, don't choke! Okay, last story! Look up at the sky tonight!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Why? Is something falling?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Mars! The red planet is passing right through a group of stars called the Beehive Cluster!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bees in space?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Not real bees! It's called the Beehive because the stars look like a swarm of bees! Mars will look like it's sitting right inside it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I see it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: If the sky is clear, look east before sunrise! Mars is the red one! Can you believe it?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I'm waking up early!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, riddle time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh! I have spots like a leopard, but I'm not a leopard! I run faster than a car, but I'm not a car! I say meow, but I'm not your house cat! What am I?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hmm... a cheetah!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: You got it! You're so smart!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Thanks for hanging out with us! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm going to watch the cheetah cam!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1013 | 转圈小行星、长角海参、6岁魔方纪录
ending_game: 小挑战：像小行星一样转圈，一分钟你能转几圈？用英语数出来，再教家人今天的单词 trickster！

vocab.def: a person who loves to play tricks and jokes
to turn around and around very fast
vocab.ex_en: the asteroid spins every five minutes
vocab.ex_zh: 小行星每五分钟转一圈

vocab.def: a hard pointy part on some animals' heads
the best score anyone has ever done

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Tuesday, October thirteenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We have three brand new stories for you today! Are you ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Born ready! Bring them on!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Two giant space rocks are spinning like crazy!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like a merry go round?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Even faster! Each one is wider than twenty football fields, and it spins all the way around every five minutes!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whoa! I would get so dizzy!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Tell me about it! Scientists just found them with a giant telescope in Chile! They spin so fast that they should break into pieces!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So why do they not fall apart?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Because they are super strong solid rocks! The scientists were totally amazed!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I ride one to school?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! You would fly right off! Spin, spin, spin, and you are gone!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! Scientists found fifty seven brand new animals deep in the ocean!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fifty seven?! Do they all have names?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One of them does! A sea cucumber with two little horns, nicknamed Loki!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Loki? Like the troublemaker god?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! That name is perfect for our word of the day later! Loki lives more than two thousand meters under the sea!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Does it play tricks on the fish down there?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Maybe it waves its little horns and says, look at me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A six year old girl solved a Rubik's Cube in about four seconds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Four seconds?! I can't even find my socks in four seconds!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I know, right?! Her name is lee-AHN yoon-JUH, from China! And she broke the women's world record! Twice!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Is she a robot?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! No, she's a real kid! Just like you! A world record means nobody in the whole world has ever done it better!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a world record for eating noodles!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That is a delicious dream! Maybe start with breakfast first!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay! Word of the day! Trickster! A trickster is someone who loves to play tricks and jokes! Like Loki the sea cucumber!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Or like me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! You said it, not me! Trickster! Say it with us, friends!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Trickster!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Spot on! Say it one more time, super silly!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: TRICK-ster!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! Perfect!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay! Tiny challenge time! Here is your mission!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A mission?! I love missions!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Spin like the super fast asteroids! See how many spins you can do in one minute! And count out loud in English! One! Two! Three!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And teach someone the word trickster today!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Yes! Teach your mom and dad! Ask them to spin with you! The whole family, spinning in circles!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Mom is going to get so dizzy!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! That is the fun part!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm off to spin!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1015 | 超级大南瓜、恐龙蘑菇、火星车纪录
ending_game: 二选一：骑在汽车一样大的南瓜上滚下山坡，还是开着机器人小车横穿火星？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

vocab.def: really, really, REALLY big
to be how heavy something is
a living thing like a mushroom, but not a plant
a small robot car that explores new places

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Thursday, October fifteenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Three gigantic stories! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic? Is that our word of the day?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, sneaky! Maybe it is, maybe it is not! Keep listening!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! A gigantic pumpkin! Three thousand one hundred fifty six pounds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Three thousand?! Heavier than my teacher's car!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Heavier than two whole cows! Ron Wallace grew it in Rhode Island! Weighed on October tenth!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did it win?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It smashed the world record! The first pumpkin ever over three thousand pounds! Funny part? One week earlier, a British man's pumpkin named Bagheera broke the record!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bagheera! Like the black panther!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Right?! But Ron's pumpkin was three hundred pounds heavier! Bye bye, Bagheera!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want to live in it! A pumpkin house!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! With a pumpkin doorbell! Ding dong! Who is at the door?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! A mushroom taller than your school ruler!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can you eat it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Whoa, not this one! Scientists found it in the forests of Yunnan, China! Over fifty centimeters tall! Almost five pounds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: As heavy as my cat!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Close! Its nickname is D-rex!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like T-rex? A dinosaur mushroom?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! Its real name is dee-ah-JOO-nus rex! Huge for a fungus! The mushroom king!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did a dinosaur plant it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh Lina, only you would ask that! It grew out of fallen wood! But get this! The biggest fungus ever in its giant family, with its own brand new family name!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The king needs a royal family!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! All hail the mushroom king!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A robot car just set a record on Mars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Who is driving it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nobody! NASA's Perseverance rover drives itself!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A self driving car on another planet?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Totally! Forty five point two kilometers! The longest drive EVER on another world! Longer than all the Moon cars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a Mars rock!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, me too! Someday, maybe!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Remember Lina's sneaky question?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Gigantic! Really, really, REALLY big! Say it with us, friends! Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One more time! Like a giant monster! Gi-GAN-tic!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gi-GAN-tic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! You sound like a true giant!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Would you rather time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh! My favorite game!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ride a gigantic pumpkin as big as a car down a hill? Or drive a robot car all the way across Mars?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The pumpkin! I want the pumpkin house on wheels!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, of course! Friends, which would YOU pick? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: If you pick Mars, bring me back a rock!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I am off to find a mushroom king!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1017 | 新恐龙命名、小熊猫起名、火星取土
ending_game: 猜谜时间：100亿年前咆哮过、长着巨爪、现在骨头睡在博物馆里——我是谁？

vocab.def: when you find something brand new that nobody knew before
a brave fighter
a tiny piece of something to study
to choose something by voting

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Saturday, October seventeenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, Saturday! The weekend is here! Three super fun stories today! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So ready!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! A brand new dinosaur just got its name! And it was hiding in a museum for one hundred years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: One hundred years? Did the museum lose a dinosaur?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Kind of! Scientists found its skull bone on an island in England, and it sat on a museum shelf since nineteen twenty four! Then this week, scientists scanned it and realized, this is a totally NEW dinosaur!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A whole century of waiting! What is its name?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Its name is in-VIK-tah-bell-ah-trix! It means unconquered female warrior!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Unconquered female warrior! Raaar!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That roar was pretty good! It was as big as a tiger, a cousin of T-rex, with giant curved claws!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! A tiny red panda cub needs a name! And you can help pick it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A red panda! Can I keep one at home?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: No way, Lina! It lives at the zoo in Washington D C! It was born in June, with red fur, a fluffy striped tail, and it munches bamboo all day!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Munch munch munch! What are the names?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: The keepers picked three! Pyra, Dolpa, and Dolly, like the famous singer Dolly Parton! Which one would YOU pick, friends? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I pick Dolly! Then it can sing me to sleep!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I wish! Story three! Japan is launching a spaceship on Monday, to a moon of Mars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Mars has moons?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Two tiny ones! This spaceship is called M M X! It flies to a moon named FOH-boss, puffs out gas to scoop up moon dust, and brings it back to Earth in the year twenty thirty one!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: That is the slowest mail package ever!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Right?! Scientists want to learn how Mars got its moons!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Discovery! A discovery is when you find something new that nobody knew before! Like the new dinosaur! Say it with us, friends! Discovery!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Discovery!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One more time, nice and loud! Discovery!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: DISCOVERY!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Bingo!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, riddle time! Here is a riddle about today's theme!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh! Go easy on me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Listen up! I roared one hundred million years ago! I had giant claws and a mighty roar! Now my bones sleep in a museum! What am I?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hmm... a tired museum guard?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Nope! Friends, shout your guess!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Oh! I know! A dinosaur!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You are onto something! A dinosaur! Great guessing, friends!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I am off to vote for Dolly the red panda!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1018 | 海牛坐飞机、歪脖子星球、面条长颈鹿
ending_game: 二选一：跟六只啃生菜的海牛宝宝一起坐飞机，还是去歪脖子星球上一边穿泳衣一边穿羽绒服？

vocab.def: one side is bigger or higher than the other side
a big, gentle sea animal that eats plants
the layer of air around a planet
a long trip from one place to another
vocab.ex_zh: 穿越澳大利亚的长途旅行

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Sunday, October eighteenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, Sunday! Three fun stories today! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I was born ready!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Six baby manatees just took an airplane ride!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Manatees on a plane? Were they the pilots?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! You crack me up! No, they were the passengers! These six babies lost their moms in Florida, and kind people rescued them! One little girl manatee named Celine was only forty eight pounds when she was found! Now she weighs four hundred twenty pounds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whoa! From teeny tiny to supersized! Go, Celine, go!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Look at you cheering for her! You are right, she grew so fast! On Wednesday, all six flew to Ohio, where two zoos will feed them lots and lots of lettuce until they are strong enough to swim home to Florida!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Six manatees on a plane? I call the window seat next to Celine!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I bet the manatees saved you a seat!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! Scientists found a planet that is lopsided!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Lop... what now?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Lopsided! It means one side is bigger than the other side! This planet is called Wasp Seventeen Bee, one thousand three hundred light years away! The James Webb telescope saw that its sky puffs out more on one side, like a lopsided balloon!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like my lopsided ponytail this morning!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Exactly like that! One side of the planet is scorching hot, and the other side is way cooler! Six hundred fifty degrees apart!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I would pack a swimsuit AND a winter coat!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I love that plan!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A baby giraffe took a super long road trip! His name is Tambi, and his name means noodle in swa HEE lee!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Noodle?! Did his parents name him after lunch?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Maybe! He is one year old, and he traveled three thousand kilometers across Australia, from one zoo to another!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did he stick his head out the window?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, I would pay to see that! The other giraffes welcomed him on Sunday morning!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Baby noodles everywhere!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Word of the day! Lopsided! Lopsided means one side is bigger or higher than the other side! Like planet Wasp Seventeen Bee, puffier on one side! Say it with us, friends! Lopsided!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Lopsided!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One more time, nice and loud! Lopsided! Do not forget the D!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: LOPSIDED!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Would you rather time! Would you rather fly on a plane with six baby manatees munching lettuce in the seats next to you?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Or ride the lopsided planet, where one side is super hot and the other side is cool and puffy?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The manatees! I will share my snacks!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: No way! I would pick the lopsided planet! Friends, which would YOU pick? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Mom always picks the weirdest one!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That is why we love her! That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I am off to pack snacks for the manatees!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1020 | 彗星跳绳、面条海虫、长毛蜗牛
ending_game: 猜谜时间：我是脏兮兮的大雪球、拖着闪亮的尾巴，从太阳系头顶飞过，几千年才拜访一次太阳——我是谁？

vocab.def: golden, hard tree sap that can trap tiny animals for millions of years
a giant snowball in space with a sparkly tail
a long, bendy arm some sea animals use to grab food
the path one thing travels around another thing in space

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Tuesday, October twentieth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Three brand new stories! Are you ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I woke up ready!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! A sneaky new comet was found in space!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Sneaky? Was it hiding?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It was hiding above the solar system! The Euclid telescope takes pictures of faraway galaxies, and this comet photo bombed one of its pictures! It is flying way over the top of the sun and the planets, like a jump rope over all of them!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A comet jumping rope! Ten jumps in a row?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, that one got me! It takes this comet thousands of years to go around the sun once! It is one point three billion kilometers away, past Jupiter!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hi, faraway comet! I see you!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! New sea worms that look like walking spaghetti!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Spaghetti that can walk? With meatballs?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: No meatballs! These worms live deep down in the Indian Ocean! They have long noodle arms called tentacles to grab food, and tiny suction cups to stick to rocks!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Sticky feet! Like the sticky hands from the toy store!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Yes! Just like those! The suction cups help them hold on!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I keep one in the bathtub?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You would, wouldn't you! They belong in the deep sea, not the bathtub!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A hairy snail, stuck in golden tree goo for ninety nine million years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A snail with HAIR? Like a tiny grandpa?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That is pure genius, and also pure silliness! When dinosaurs walked the earth, this little snail crawled through sticky tree sap, got stuck, and the sap turned hard and golden! Now it is amber, and we can still see the snail's hair!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Does it have a tiny comb for its tiny hair?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, I did NOT see that coming! No comb! But its hair helped it feel the world!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Amber! Amber is golden, hard tree sap that can trap tiny animals for millions of years! Say it with us, friends! Amber!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Amber!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Louder! AMBER!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: AMBER!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You got it, little explorer! And you too, friends!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Riddle time! I am a giant dirty snowball with a sparkly tail! I fly over the top of the solar system, and I take thousands of years to visit the sun! What am I?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hmm... a snowman in space?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Now THAT is a plan, but no! Friends, shout the answer! A comet!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A comet!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That is all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye bye! I am going to jump rope like a comet!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1022 | 毒猴现身、小飞象章鱼、翻筋斗蛇
ending_game: 小挑战：今天把单词 cartwheel 教给一个人，再和他一起翻个侧手翻——翻不起来，在草地上滚一圈也算！

vocab.def: a fun sideways roll, hands first, then feet, then hands
a poison some animals use to protect themselves
a small furry animal with huge eyes that moves very slowly
a flat piece that moves up and down

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back to Little English News! I am Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I am Lina! It is Thursday, October twenty-second!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, I am SO happy it is Thursday! Three brand new stories are waiting!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I woke up ready! Give me the news!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! A cute little monkey with venom is back!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Venom? Like, poison? In a cute monkey?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! It is called a slow loris! Say it with me, slow LOR iss!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Slow LOR iss! Sounds like a sleepy loris!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! It does sound sleepy! It has huge eyes and reddish brown fur, like a tiny storybook animal! Scientists thought it was gone, but it was found alive on an island called BANG kuh!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: BANG kuh! That sounds like a drum!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it! Bang, bang, kuh! No one had seen one in science books for almost one hundred years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Was it hiding under the bed?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I like how you think! It was hiding in the forest! And listen, its bite has venom, so look, do not touch!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Cute face, spicy bite!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! Deep sea scientists just met the cutest octopus ever!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: An octopus? Does it have eight arms for hugging?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Eight arms, and two floppy ear flaps! It is called a Dumbo octopus, because its flaps look like Dumbo the elephant ears!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: An octopus with elephant ears? That is silly!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I know, right? Scientists were exploring a deep sea mountain near Palau, and this little guy just bopped into view! One scientist said, I am shaking, I am so excited!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I would shake too! Was it tiny?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Super tiny and super rare! They live way down deep where it is dark and cold. Most people never ever see one!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Lucky scientists! Can I keep one as a pet?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! They need the deep dark sea to be happy. But we can draw one! Eight arms, two floppy ears, big smile!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I am drawing mine with a crown! The queen of the deep sea!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! Some snakes do cartwheels!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Snakes? Doing cartwheels? Like gymnasts?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Just like gymnasts! When danger comes, these little snakes roll away like a wheel, head over tail, head over tail!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Vroom vroom, snake wheel!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Zoom! They can roll almost eight miles per hour! That is faster than you riding your scooter!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A scooter snake! I want to race it!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I would cheer for you! But please do not race wild snakes!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Cartwheel! A cartwheel is when you roll sideways like a wheel, hands, then feet, then hands! Say it with us, friends! Cartwheel!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Cartwheel!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Louder! CARTWHEEL!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: CARTWHEEL!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: YES! You crushed it! And you too, friends!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Tiny challenge time! Teach one person the word cartwheel today, and try one cartwheel together! If you cannot do one yet, rolling on soft grass totally counts!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I am going to teach grandma!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Grandma doing cartwheels? Somebody get the camera! That is all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye bye! I am going to cartwheel to the kitchen!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1024 | 巨型吹风机、变色虾眼、深海巨虫
ending_game: 谜语时间：我比大人还高、会吹热风，但我不是龙——我是谁？答案：巨型吹风机！

vocab.def: a little button that turns something on or off
something new that someone makes for the first time
a sea animal with a hard shell that looks like a giant woodlouse
the best ever in something

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back to Little English News! I am Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I am Lina! It is Saturday, October twenty-fourth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Three brand new stories today!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: What is first?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Two kids dreamed up a giant hairdryer, and engineers actually built it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A giant hairdryer? As big as a house?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Almost as tall as a grown-up! Five feet nine inches long and five feet three inches tall! About seven times bigger than a normal hairdryer!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whoa! Does it actually blow air?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It really works! A motor fan blows the air, and oven heating parts make it hot!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whose wild idea was that?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Two kids, Kiki and Thea! More than five thousand kids sent in invention ideas, and their giant hairdryer won!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So kids can dream it, and grown-ups build it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That is the magic! The same team once built the biggest electric toothbrush in the world! And now their giant hairdryer is in the Guinness World Records book for twenty twenty-seven!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a giant toothbrush too!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Classic Lina! Story two! A shrimp with superpower eyes!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A shrimp? With superpowers? Does it fly?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not fly, but see! This mantis shrimp sees colors we cannot even imagine! Its eyes work like a light switch! One color turns it on, another turns it off!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So its eyes go click clack, click clack?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Click clack, you said it! Four of its color catchers can flip back and forth like switches!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I borrow those eyes for hide and seek?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Brilliant thinking! With those eyes, nobody could ever hide from you!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A giant sea bug was hiding in a museum!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A bug? In a museum? Was it on vacation?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! On a shelf! Scientists in Germany opened an old museum drawer and found a giant isopod from Puerto Rico, sitting there since the nineteen eighties under the wrong name!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A giant bug with the wrong name tag? Poor guy!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Poor guy indeed! Then scientists took a super close look, and surprise! A brand new species!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: How giant is giant? As big as my backpack?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Almost! Almost thirteen inches long! It lives deep down in the dark sea, and it looks like a giant woodlouse!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A giant roly poly of the deep sea! Does it roll into a ball?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You read my mind!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Switch! A switch is a little button that turns something on or off! Say it with us, friends! Switch!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Switch!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Louder! SWITCH!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: SWITCH!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Perfect! You sounded like true scientists! And you too, friends!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Riddle time! Listen close! I am bigger than a grown-up, I blow hot air, but I am not a dragon! What am I?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hmm! A giant... hairdryer?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ding ding ding! Correct! A giant hairdryer! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye bye! I am drawing my giant hairdryer!

photos.credit: Photo: Paul Michael Hughes / Guinness World Records
Photo: Peter Southwood / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1025 | 女巫摩天轮、袋鼠闯赛道、狗狗大侦探
ending_game: 二选一：跟 184 个女巫一起坐摩天轮，还是看一场小袋鼠蹦上赛道的摩托车比赛？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

vocab.def: to smell something with your nose
a woman in stories who wears a pointy hat and does magic
clothes you wear to look like someone or something else
a long loose coat with no sleeves
a small animal like a kangaroo that hops on two back legs
vocab.ex_en: a wallaby hops onto the track

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back to Little English News! I am Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I am Lina! It is Sunday, October twenty fifth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Three brand new stories today, and one is Halloween spooky!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Spooky? A ghost story?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Even better! Story one! One hundred eighty four witches rode a giant wheel!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Real witches? On a wheel?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Real people dressed as witches! In Orlando, one hundred eighty four people in pointy hats and black cloaks rode the Orlando Eye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The Orlando Eye? Is that a giant eyeball?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That would be spooky! No, it is a giant wheel, four hundred feet tall!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Were the witches scared?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not one bit! They rode at sunset, and Peppa Pig came too, dressed as a witch!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Peppa Pig as a witch? Did she bring her muddy puddles?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Muddy puddles! I love it! A LEGO witch came too, and together they set a brand new world record!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I be witch number one hundred eighty five?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You would be the silliest one!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! A wallaby crashed a motorbike race!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A wallaby? What is that?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: A small cousin of the kangaroo! It hops on two back legs, just smaller and bouncier!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did the wallaby ride a motorbike too?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: No bike for our wallaby! In Australia, during a big motorbike race, it hopped right onto the racetrack, and the race had to stop!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The race stopped? For a wallaby?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: A red flag went up, and everybody waited while the wallaby bounced along the edge of the track!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Was it scared? Was it hurt?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not hurt at all! It hopped away safe and sound, and the fans joked online, get Skippy a bike!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A dog with a super nose won a big prize!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A dog? What did she sniff out?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Even cooler! Her name is SKEE ah, a black Labrador from Scotland! She sniffs out a slimy sea creature called sea vomit!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Sea vomit? Yuck!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It is gross! It hides where people cannot see it, but SKEE ah can smell it from far away!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So she is a detective dog?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it! She started as a mountain rescue dog, and now she guards the sea! She just won Animal of the Year!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a super nose too!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: With your nose, you would sniff out every cookie in the house!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Sniff! Sniff means to smell something with your nose! SKEE ah sniffs out the slimy sea creature! Say it with us, friends! Sniff!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Sniff!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Louder! SNIFF!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: SNIFF!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Amazing! You sound like real detective dogs! And you too, friends!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Time for our ending game! Would you rather ride a giant wheel with one hundred eighty four witches, or watch a motorbike race where a wallaby hops onto the track?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The witches! I want a pointy hat! What about you, friends? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Team witches, or team wallaby? Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye bye! I am going to practice my witch laugh!

photos.credit: Photo: The Orlando Eye / Merlin Entertainments
Photo: John Robert McPherson / Wikimedia Commons
Photo: International Fund for Animal Welfare

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1027 | 百年新企鹅、狮子宝宝、绿色星星
ending_game: 小挑战：听完后像企鹅一样摇摇摆摆地穿过房间，并把今天的单词 waddle 教给一个人！

vocab.def: to walk with short steps, side to side, like a penguin
vocab.ex_zh: 像企鹅一样摇摇摆摆地走

vocab.def: a piece of land with water all around it
a loud, deep sound a lion makes
to shine with small, quick flashes of light

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back to Little English News! I am Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I am Lina! It is Tuesday, October twenty seventh!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We have three wonderful stories today, and one took scientists one hundred years to notice!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: One hundred years? Did someone wait one hundred years for lunch?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I love the way your brain works! No lunch today, Lina. Story one is about a penguin!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A penguin? Can it waddle to school with me?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Brilliant thinking, Lina! This penguin waddles on faraway islands in the southern Indian Ocean, near Antarctica!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Is it a brand new penguin?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Wow, you spotted the fun part right away! It looks just like other gentoo penguins, with a white belly and orange feet, but its genes tell a different story!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The genes said, surprise, I am a new penguin!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You said that perfectly! It is the first new penguin species in more than one hundred years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a penguin that waddles to school with me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You would need a very cold backpack for that! Story two! Two baby lions were born in Scotland!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Baby lions? Do they roar already?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not yet! They are still tiny and sleepy in their den at Edinburgh Zoo! Their mom is Bindee, and their dad is Jay!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bindee and Jay! Those are sweet names!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: These are the first lion cubs born at that zoo in seven years! Keepers watched on a camera, so mom could rest in peace and quiet!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Seven years? That is older than me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Story three! Scientists found a star that could be green!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A green star? Like a green traffic light in the sky?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: What a picture! Stars are usually red or white or blue, and no one had ever found a green one before!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Why is this one green?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You always find the best question hiding inside the story! This tiny old star is called a white dwarf, and rocky bits from old planets changed its color!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So the star ate planet crumbs and turned green?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That is a wonderful way to put it! Scientists worked out that its light could look green to our eyes!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Waddle! Waddle means to walk with short steps, side to side, like a penguin! Say it with us, friends! Waddle!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Waddle!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Beautiful! One more time, friends! Waddle!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Waddle!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Time for our ending game! Here is your tiny challenge! After listening, waddle across the room like a penguin, and teach one person today's word, waddle!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I am going to waddle to the kitchen and teach mom! Waddle, waddle, waddle!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That is the spirit! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye bye! I am off to waddle!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1029 | 吃水果的恐龙、冥王星外新世界、巨型漫画书
ending_game: 猜谜时间：我比你的书包还高、重得像块砖，还会用图画讲故事——我是谁？答案：巨型漫画书！

vocab.def: something much smaller than usual of its kind
to chew something noisily and with enthusiasm
to see or notice something, especially after looking
a book that tells a story in pictures

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hi friends, welcome back to Little English News! I am Mia, and Lina is here with me!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hi everyone! I brought my silliest questions today!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It is Thursday, October twenty-ninth, and we have three wonderful stories!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: First story first! Tell me, tell me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Scientists found a dinosaur that loved fruit! It lived long ago, next to Tyrannosaurus rex!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A dinosaur that ate fruit? Did it have fruit salad for lunch every day?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That picture just made my day! It was about the size of a turkey, with feathers and no teeth, but strong jaws for mashing soft fruit!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So it was a fruit mashing machine! Can I feed it a banana?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You would need a time machine and a very big banana! Scientists call it the hell chicken, from Hell Creek, where its bones were found!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hell chicken! That is the funniest dinosaur name ever! Does it go cluck cluck?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it! It never said cluck! It just munched fruit all day long!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! Scientists found a brand new icy world, far, far beyond Pluto!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A new planet? Can I drive it to school?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! You would need a parking lot bigger than your school! It is Texas sized, and sits forty-six times farther from the sun than Earth!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Forty-six times? Even my bike cannot get there!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! It hid in a crowd of stars, until a giant camera in Chile spotted it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So it played hide and seek with the whole world, and lost!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: You got it in one guess! Scientists think it could be a new dwarf planet! Now, word of the day!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Word time! Word time!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Dwarf! A dwarf is something much smaller than usual of its kind! Say it with us, friends! Dwarf!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Dwarf! Dwarf! It sounds so small and cute!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Music to my ears! One more time, friends! Dwarf!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! Get ready for the biggest comic book in the whole world!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A comic book? Is it bigger than my school bag?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, you are going to love this one! It is called Gentle Giant, and it is the largest comic book ever made! It is more than one meter tall, it weighs almost three kilograms, as heavy as a brick, and only fifty-five copies were made! People measured it at a huge comic book show in New York!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A book as heavy as a brick? I would need a bed as big as a boat to read it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Time for our ending game! Game time is my favorite time!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Riddle time! I am taller than your school bag, I weigh as much as a brick, and I tell a story in pictures. What am I?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Hmm! Taller than my school bag... and pictures... Is it the giant comic book?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! The giant comic book! You solved it all by yourself!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Yay! I am the riddle champion!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time!
